meta.name: add-atomic-chat-tool
meta.description: Add Atomic Chat MCP server so the container agent can call local models served by the Atomic Chat desktop app via its OpenAI-compatible API.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让容器 agent 调用本地 AI 模型
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在容器中通过 OpenAI 兼容接口调用本地模型。
copy.tagline_en: Enable container agent to call local AI models
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to call local models from a container via OpenAI-compatible API.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 可以调用本地 Atomic Chat 桌面应用中的模型来回答问题或执行任务。它会先列出可用模型，然后向指定模型发送提示并返回结果。
howto.when: 当用户要求使用本地模型（如“用 atomic chat 回答”）或明确指定调用 atomic_chat_generate 工具时触发。

say.text: 用 atomic chat 告诉我法国的首都是什么。
say.note: Claude 会列出模型并选择一个生成回答。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can call local models served by the Atomic Chat desktop app to answer questions or perform tasks. It first lists available models, then sends a prompt to a specified model and returns the response.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to use a local model (e.g., "use atomic chat to answer") or explicitly requests the atomic_chat_generate tool.

say_en.text: Use atomic chat to tell me the capital of France.
say_en.note: Claude will list models and pick one to generate an answer.

say_en.text: Use the atomic_chat_generate tool with model llama3.2-3b-instruct to answer: what is 1+1?
say_en.note: Claude will directly call the specified model to generate a result.
